title: Whiteboard explainer for fintech terms
description: Teach three terms a buyer should know, drawn like a whiteboard lesson.
prompt: Open with the confusing term as a question. For each of three terms: write the term, underline it, give a plain-English definition under 18 words, then a tiny diagram. Tie the last term to how the product handles it, with a real screenshot. No jargon inside definitions.
